class MaxFlow:
    def __init__(self, N, M):
        self.N = N
        self.M = M
        self.head = [-1] * N
        self.vv = [0] * M
        self.nxt = [0] * M
        self.cap = [0] * M
        self.flow = [0] * M
        self.e = 0
        self.dist = [-1] * N
        self.cur = [0] * N

    def init(self):
        self.head = [-1] * self.N
        self.e = 0

    def addEdge(self, u, v, c):
        e = self.e
        self.vv[e] = v
        self.nxt[e] = self.head[u]
        self.cap[e] = c
        self.flow[e] = 0
        self.head[u] = e
        self.e += 1
        e = self.e
        self.vv[e] = u
        self.nxt[e] = self.head[v]
        self.cap[e] = 0
        self.flow[e] = 0
        self.head[v] = e
        self.e += 1

    def bfs(self, s, t):
        for i in range(self.N):
            self.dist[i] = -1
        self.dist[s] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            i = self.head[u]
            while i != -1:
                v = self.vv[i]
                if self.dist[v] == -1 and self.cap[i] > self.flow[i]:
                    self.dist[v] = self.dist[u] + 1
                    q.append(v)
                i = self.nxt[i]
        return self.dist[t] != -1

    def dfs(self, u, t, a):
        if u == t or a == 0:
            return a
        ret = 0
        i = self.cur[u]
        while i != -1:
            v = self.vv[i]
            if self.dist[v] == self.dist[u] + 1 and self.cap[i] - self.flow[i] > 0:
                f = self.dfs(v, t, min(a, self.cap[i] - self.flow[i]))
                if f > 0:
                    self.flow[i] += f
                    self.flow[i ^ 1] -= f
                    a -= f
                    ret += f
                    if a == 0:
                        break
            i = self.nxt[self.cur[u]]
            self.cur[u] = i
        return ret

    def maxFlow(self, s, t):
        flow = 0
        while self.bfs(s, t):
            self.cur = self.head[:]
            flow += self.dfs(s, t, 10**9)
        return flow
